80478.commentary: (DNt) nippeso nippisanaṃ cuṇṇaṃ viya karaṇaṃ. nippisantī'ti vā nippesā, nippesā'y'eva nippesikā, nippisanaṃ vā nippeso, taṃ karontī'ti'pi nippesikā. (MNt) attavisayalābhahetu akkosana-khuṃsana-vambhan'ādi-vasena pisanaṃ ghaṭṭanaṃ viheṭhanaṃ nippeso.

examples.text: gabbho hi vātena, pāṇakehi, kammunā cā'ti tīhi kāraṇehi vinassati. tattha vātena vinassante nibbāpanīyaṃ sītalaṃ bhesajjaṃ deti, pāṇakehi vinassante pāṇakānaṃ paṭikammaṃ karoti, kammunā vinassante pana buddhā'pi paṭibāhituṃ na sakkonti.
kaṇṇajappanan'ti kaṇṇehi saddaṃ assavan'atthāya vijjāya jappanaṃ. taṃ kira jappitvā vinicchayaṭṭhāne yaṃ icchati, taṃ bhaṇati, paccatthiko taṃ na suṇāti, tato paṭivacanaṃ sampādetuṃ na sakkoti.

80498.commentary: (DNa) vassakammaṃ vossakamman'ti ettha vasso'ti puriso, vosso'ti paṇḍako. iti vossassa vassakaraṇaṃ vassakammaṃ, vassassa vossakaraṇaṃ vossakammaṃ. taṃ pana karonto acchandikabhāvamattaṃ pāpeti, na liṅgaṃ antaradhāpetuṃ sakkoti.
